summary.en: The Chrome offline dino, taken straight from the Chromium source — as authentic as it gets.
summary.zh: 从 Chromium 源码里扒出来的断网小恐龙，原汁原味还原。

description.en: Leap over cacti with space or up, duck under pterodactyls by holding down. The farther you run the higher you score, and the game keeps speeding up.
description.zh: 空格或上键跳跃躲仙人掌，按住下键下蹲躲飞鸟，跑得越远分越高，速度持续加快。

howto.en: Space or up arrow to jump, down arrow to duck.

tip.en: The most universally recognized mini-game on the list — zero tutorial needed, fun for every age. Pure static files that host anywhere in one click, and it makes a delightful 404-page easter egg.
tip.zh: 国民认知度最高的小游戏，无需教程、老少皆宜。纯静态文件，可整站一键托管；也适合做成 404 页面的彩蛋。
